title: Sneak Peek: Live Sports is Coming to Viumo! ⚽🔥🚀

blocks.content:
Dear Viumo Family,

You flooded our inbox, you dropped the requests, and we heard you loud and clear! 👂🔥

We are thrilled to give you a secret sneak peek into our upcoming major release: **LIVE SPORTS IS OFFICIALLY ON THE WAY!** ⚽🥊🏀

In our next update, you will be able to watch live sporting events as they unfold—second by second—right inside Viumo. We’re placing a dedicated **Live Sports** section directly inside your **Profile** menu for instant access.

⚡ **Help Us Hit 500 Users Before Kickoff!**
We are currently fine-tuning high-speed streams behind the scenes to guarantee zero buffering when game time hits. 

While we finish building, we need your help! Viumo is still intimate, lean, and growing—we are closing in on our **500-user milestone**. Features like this take massive effort, and we want to launch this for our biggest crowd yet.

Do not keep Viumo a secret! Share the app with your group chats, friends, and matchday crew today so everyone is ready when the next update drops. 🍿⚽
